style: Premium, crisp, perfectly legible product-UI illustration for a car-dealer marketing website. Dark theme: near-black #050505 surroundings, #0b0d12 app background, #111827 cards, subtle 1px white borders at low opacity, rounded corners, electric-blue #3b82f6 accents with a soft blue glow. Clean geometric sans-serif typography (Inter-like), generous spacing, every word spelled exactly as written in quotes. No company logos, no AI-product logos or wordmarks, no browser brand, no watermarks, no people, and no extra text beyond what is specified.
rules: This is a neutral website template: the only business name anywhere is the plain placeholder wordmark "Your Dealership", and no other dealership, company, car make or car model name appears. Every vehicle is a generic debadged vehicle: no emblems, badges, grille logos, model lettering or license plates on the bodywork. No digits or numerals anywhere in the image. No prices, mileage figures, model years, VINs, phone numbers, street addresses, web addresses, star ratings, review counts or award badges anywhere. Phone status bars show no clock and no numbers, and there is no operating-system taskbar, dock or clock. Every device and card sits fully inside the frame with clear margin on all sides, so nothing is cut off.

images.scene: A laptop and a phone side by side on a near-black surface, both front-on and both showing the same dealership website template concept, with no browser brand. The laptop browser has an empty rounded address bar with only a small lock icon. The website header shows the plain text wordmark "Your Dealership" on the left and the menu "Inventory", "Our store", "Contact" on the right. Below it a wide homepage hero: a realistic photo of a dark blue debadged midsize SUV parked outdoors in warm late-afternoon light, next to the headline "Find your next vehicle" and a white rounded button labeled "Browse inventory". Under the hero, a row of three vehicle cards with realistic photos of a debadged SUV, a debadged sedan and a debadged pickup truck, each card labeled only "SUV", "Sedan" or "Truck", with a short gray placeholder bar where details would go. The phone shows the same site's vehicle page for the SUV: the photo at the top, then two side-by-side buttons "Call the store" and "Text us", then four rows labeled "Price", "Mileage", "Trim" and "Exterior color", each followed by a soft gray placeholder bar instead of a value. The laptop keyboard keys are completely blank and smooth, with no letters, numbers, symbols or markings on any key. Every vehicle grille is plain, with no emblem and no blank badge plate.
